_rules: The first installed family of a list is used; none installed throws and the game stops (GlyphAtlas.cpp:230-246; ADR-030 decision 2).
Rasterized by DirectWrite in grayscale, NATURAL_SYMMETRIC, at round(sizeUnits x scale) px, at least 1 (GlyphAtlas.cpp:288-290; UiPipeline.cpp:28-31).
Characters: printable ASCII plus U+00B7 middle dot and U+00D7 multiplication sign; any other shows "?" (GlyphAtlas.h:63-68; ADR-030 decision 3).
Advances, pen position, top and tracking are whole pixels (GlyphAtlas.cpp:276; UiPipeline.cpp:270-272).
Line box = ceil(ascent+descent+lineGap) from the font's metrics (GlyphAtlas.cpp:258-259); its numeric value per face: Not specified (depends on the installed font).

scale.usedBy: No text at HEAD: every layout text names another face (grep of Typeface::Body finds only Hud.h:670 and Hud.cpp:3010). It is rasterized but not drawn.

scale.role: Title: window subject, panel first line, Ore stockpile, Ore box, Queue label and cost, close mark, menu title, outcome title, away "since"

Label: small spaced capitals (section labels, title-bar labels, NAME, SAVED, RETREAT, row labels, units) with tracking; untracked for arrow marks, key caps, chip names, armor/reach, notes, lock and need lines, strength initials, WAITING FOR ORE

Name: button labels, card and design names, HUD panel lines (status, territory, alerts, hint, connection), selection lines after the first, queue rows, Controls, orders and away lines, menu subtitle and notice, HUD retreat cells, stepper
Figure: costs (with the gem), income, territory and status figures, stat values, queue percent and index, name count, damage change
LargeFigure: a damage card's per-ship damage per second
Detail: a part card's numbers and note, chip code, per-100-ore, designer hint, Queue detail, production code line and time, topic effect lines and time

pixelSizes._method: round(sizeRefUnits x scale), at least 1 (UiPipeline.cpp:28-31); scale = factor x min(w/1920, h/1080) (Hud.cpp:3029-3033). Computed by A5.

contrast._method: WCAG 2 ratio (L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05) of relative luminances L = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B taken directly from the linear constants (they are linear sRGB, so no decoding); grounds composited over black at their alpha in linear, a hatched ground counted both as stripe and as gap - the method of ADR-062 decision 3 and HudTests.cpp:318-360. Computed by A5 in Python from the constants at HEAD.

space._units: reference units on the 1920x1080 frame (pixels at 1080p), Hud.cpp unless named

MARGIN.meaning: screen edge to every anchored panel; between windows side by side

PADDING.meaning: panel edge to its content; window title left inset

PANEL_GAP.meaning: between stacked HUD panels; minimap to selection

TERRITORY_INSET_UNITS.meaning: top/bottom room in the status, territory, alerts and connection panels

COLUMN_LEAST_UNITS.meaning: least width of the Ore/status/territory/alerts column; grows to its widest line

production.source: Hud.cpp:1612-1624; optionWidth computed by A5 as (478 - 48 - 8)/2

research.source: Hud.cpp:1627-1630; Hud.h:400-401; topicWidth computed by A5 as (560 - 48 - 8)/2

scale.spare: On a non-16:9 screen the spare width or height goes between the anchors (ADR-006 decision 5): every anchor is computed from screenWidthUnits = width/scale and screenHeightUnits = height/scale (Hud.cpp:3085-3086).

interfaceSteps.limit: A step up only while the designer (every component), the Controls window, and the orders and away windows at their tallest fit between MARGINs; on the menu the Controls window alone (Hud.h:863-866, Hud.cpp:3035-3054). Steps down to the largest that fits on a new screen size or match (Hud.cpp:3056-3073).
interfaceSteps.notScaledByFactor: Entity bars (Hud.cpp:3096 uses Scale without factor), the selection ring (GameClient.cpp:1443), the stars (ADR-070 decision 7).

anchors.statusPanel: under the Ore panel, PANEL_GAP below (Hud.cpp:3160, 3250)
anchors.territoryPanel: under the status panel's kept place (Hud.cpp:3161, 3177)
anchors.selectionAndButtons: bottom-middle as one pair, bottom-aligned, never over the minimap (Hud.cpp:3369-3371)
anchors.productionResearch: side by side under the status panel at WINDOWS_TOP (Hud.cpp:3646-3650, 1635)

frame.pixelSnapping: Text pen, top and tracking, sprites and entity bars are snapped to whole pixels (UiPipeline.cpp:270-272, 304; Hud.cpp:3098-3106); panels and outlines are not (UiPipeline.cpp:236-241).

renderTargets.backBuffer: R8G8B8A8_UNORM, written through an R8G8B8A8_UNORM_SRGB view (Renderer.cpp:22; Renderer.h:25)

drawOrder: bloom from the scene, added in the resolve (Renderer.cpp:416-450)
layer 0 = HUD, then each window back to front; per layer: panels, lines, sprites, texts (GameClient.cpp:1300-1333; Hud.h:714-715)

LINE_UNITS.use: outline of cards, buttons, fields, boxes; dividers; header band edge; ship-bar outline

SECTOR_LINE_UNITS.use: minimap sector borders and outlines, alert squares

ORE_OUTLINE_UNITS.use: outline of an ore asteroid's minimap mark

minimapMarks.rule: least size; a mark is max(least, 2 x radius at the map scale) (Hud.cpp:3505)

spriteStroke.value: 1/12 of the sprite's pixel size, at least 1 px

cornerBracket.shape: an L along the top and left edges, mirrored for the other three corners (GlyphAtlas.h:30-31)

hatching.rule: A pixel is striped where fmod(x + y, period) < stripe, in back-buffer pixels: diagonal stripes rising to the right at 45 degrees, laid on the screen so neighboring hatched panels line up. Measured along a row: 2 of every 7 units; across the stripe: about 1.41 of every 4.95 units (computed by A5). Scaled by the layout scale, factor included.
uses: title bar and header band: TITLE_HATCH_COLOR over WINDOW_COLOR
locked part card / blocked topic: LOCKED_HATCH_COLOR over LOCKED_COLOR
minimap suppressed sector: side color at 0.35

scene.gridAndModelLines: 1 px at any zoom (ADR-028 decision 1; ADR-027)

SELECTION_RING_UNITS.rule: round(3 x screen scale) one-pixel rings a pixel apart (GameClient.cpp:1443-1456; ADR-067)
